missingness_policy: Exclude a base-eligible row if any of the 19 fields has an official missing/inapplicable code; retain all reasons and raw codes. MARRY42X=6 is inapplicable. An unknown or out-of-codebook code is a validation error, not an added exclusion. No imputation, clipping, winsorization or recoding negative codes to no. Source imputation flags retained.
design_policy: One common main-effects design per pair for all future methods. Continuous fields unchanged. Categorical fields exported as source code plus label; numeric design uses one-hot indicators for every observed valid level except smallest observed reference. Zero-count source levels documented, not represented by unidentified all-zero coefficients. Constant fields documented without adding unidentified columns. Same schema for every method on a pair; no interaction/nonlinear term selection, no scoring or fitting. Matching distance/scaling is a later declared algorithm choice.
summaries: For each pair, overall and each race: n,sumW, weight ESS; covariate weighted mean and population-denominator SD or per-level weighted proportion. No outcome means or effects.
execution: One preprocessing run after this frozen contract; no counts-based specification change; no statistical models or matching.
